text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 47-48 पर कहानी पढ़ो, फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 47-48 par kahani padho, phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the story on pages 47–48 of your book, then answer.

steps.question: Who was invited to the court to draw the portrait of the king?

questionMeaning.hi: राजा का चित्र बनाने के लिए दरबार में किसे बुलाया गया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Raja ka chitra banaane ke liye darbaar mein kise bulaaya gaya?

steps.modelAnswer: Raja Varma, a brilliant artist, was invited to the court to draw the portrait of the king.

modelMeaning.hi: एक प्रतिभाशाली चित्रकार राजा वर्मा को राजा का चित्र बनाने के लिए दरबार में बुलाया गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ek pratibhaashaali chitrakaar Raja Varma ko raja ka chitra banaane ke liye darbaar mein bulaaya gaya.

steps.question: Why did Raja Varma become close and dear to the king?

questionMeaning.hi: राजा वर्मा राजा के क़रीबी और प्यारे क्यों बने?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Raja Varma raja ke kareebi aur pyaare kyon bane?

options: because of his genius as an artist
because he was the king's son
steps.answer: because of his genius as an artist
steps.modelAnswer: Raja Varma became close and dear to the king because of his genius. His portrait of the king seemed to come alive.

modelMeaning.hi: राजा वर्मा अपनी प्रतिभा के कारण राजा के क़रीबी बने। उनका बनाया राजा का चित्र जैसे जीवित लगता था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raja Varma apni pratibha ke kaaran raja ke kareebi bane. Unka banaaya raja ka chitra jaise jeevit lagta tha.

steps.question: Why were the people unhappy with the chief minister's administration?

questionMeaning.hi: लोग मुख्यमंत्री के काम से नाख़ुश क्यों थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Log mukhyamantri ke kaam se naakhush kyon the?

options: His hasty decisions and bad management caused chaos.
He never came to the court.
steps.answer: His hasty decisions and bad management caused chaos.
steps.modelAnswer: The people were unhappy because Raja Varma had no experience of administration. His hasty decisions and bad management threw everything into disorder and chaos.

modelMeaning.hi: लोग नाख़ुश थे क्योंकि राजा वर्मा को राज चलाने का कोई अनुभव नहीं था। उनके जल्दबाज़ी के फ़ैसलों और बुरे प्रबंधन से सब गड़बड़ हो गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Log naakhush the kyonki Raja Varma ko raaj chalaane ka koi anubhav nahi tha. Unke jaldbaazi ke faislon aur bure prabandhan se sab gadbad ho gaya.

steps.question: Who wanted Tenali Raman's help?

questionMeaning.hi: तेनाली रामन की मदद किसने माँगी?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tenali Raman ki madad kisne maangi?

steps.modelAnswer: The elders of the town wanted Tenali Raman's help to get rid of the inept chief minister.

modelMeaning.hi: नगर के बुज़ुर्गों ने नाकाबिल मुख्यमंत्री से छुटकारे के लिए तेनाली रामन की मदद माँगी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nagar ke buzurgon ne naakaabil mukhyamantri se chhutkaare ke liye Tenali Raman ki madad maangi.

steps.question: Who was given the job of preparing the food in Tenali Raman's house?

questionMeaning.hi: तेनाली रामन के घर खाना बनाने का काम किसे मिला?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tenali Raman ke ghar khaana banaane ka kaam kise mila?

steps.modelAnswer: A very good carpenter was given the job of preparing the food.

modelMeaning.hi: एक बहुत अच्छे बढ़ई को खाना बनाने का काम दिया गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ek bahut achhe badhai ko khaana banaane ka kaam diya gaya.

steps.question: Did the cook prepare very tasty food? Why not?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या रसोइए ने स्वादिष्ट खाना बनाया? क्यों नहीं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya rasoiye ne swaadisht khaana banaaya? Kyon nahi?

options: No, because he was a carpenter, not a cook.
No, because there was no salt.
steps.answer: No, because he was a carpenter, not a cook.
steps.modelAnswer: No. The food was badly cooked and unbearably hot because the cook was a carpenter, not a cook.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं। खाना बुरी तरह पका और बहुत तीखा था क्योंकि बनाने वाला रसोइया नहीं, बढ़ई था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi. Khaana buri tarah paka aur bahut teekha tha kyonki banaane waala rasoiya nahi, badhai tha.

steps.question: Why did Tenali Raman invite the king, the queen and some courtiers to his house?

questionMeaning.hi: तेनाली रामन ने राजा, रानी और दरबारियों को घर क्यों बुलाया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tenali Raman ne raja, rani aur darbaariyon ko ghar kyon bulaaya?

options: to make the king realise his mistake
steps.answer: to make the king realise his mistake
steps.modelAnswer: Tenali Raman invited them to lunch to make the king realise his mistake of making an artist the chief minister.

modelMeaning.hi: तेनाली रामन ने उन्हें खाने पर बुलाया ताकि राजा को चित्रकार को मुख्यमंत्री बनाने की गलती समझ आए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Tenali Raman ne unhe khaane par bulaaya taaki raja ko chitrakaar ko mukhyamantri banaane ki galti samajh aaye.

steps.question: How did the king realise his mistake?

questionMeaning.hi: राजा को अपनी गलती कैसे समझ आई?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Raja ko apni galti kaise samajh aayi?

options: Raman asked: if an artist can be a chief minister, can't a carpenter be a cook?
steps.answer: Raman asked: if an artist can be a chief minister, can't a carpenter be a cook?
steps.modelAnswer: Tenali Raman asked the king, ‘If an artist can become a chief minister, can't a carpenter become a cook?’ The king at once understood his mistake.

modelMeaning.hi: तेनाली रामन ने पूछा, ‘अगर एक चित्रकार मुख्यमंत्री बन सकता है, तो बढ़ई रसोइया क्यों नहीं?’ राजा तुरंत अपनी गलती समझ गए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Tenali Raman ne poochha, ‘Agar ek chitrakaar mukhyamantri ban sakta hai, to badhai rasoiya kyon nahi?’ Raja turant apni galti samajh gaye.

steps.question: When did Raja Varma resign from his post?

questionMeaning.hi: राजा वर्मा ने पद से इस्तीफ़ा कब दिया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Raja Varma ne pad se istifa kab diya?

options: when he came to know about the incident at Raman's house
steps.answer: when he came to know about the incident at Raman's house
steps.modelAnswer: Raja Varma resigned immediately when he came to know about the awkward incident at Raman's house.

modelMeaning.hi: रामन के घर की घटना का पता चलते ही राजा वर्मा ने तुरंत इस्तीफ़ा दे दिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raman ke ghar ki ghatna ka pata chalte hi Raja Varma ne turant istifa de diya.

steps.question: Was Raja Varma happy as the chief minister? Why not?

questionMeaning.hi: क्या राजा वर्मा मुख्यमंत्री बनकर ख़ुश थे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kya Raja Varma mukhyamantri bankar khush the?

options: No, he was happy to remain an artist.
steps.answer: No, he was happy to remain an artist.
steps.modelAnswer: No. He had no experience of administration. Later he told Tenali Raman that he was happy to remain an artist.

modelMeaning.hi: नहीं। उन्हें राज चलाने का अनुभव नहीं था। बाद में उन्होंने तेनाली रामन से कहा कि वे चित्रकार रहकर ही ख़ुश हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Nahi. Unhe raaj chalaane ka anubhav nahi tha. Baad mein unhone Tenali Raman se kaha ki woh chitrakaar rehkar hi khush hain.

steps.question: The king invited ___ to the court and asked him to draw his portrait.
